description: Unified envelope for phantom-ink collection scripts AND the cross-machine agent event bus. Collection scripts emit an array of these to stdout (upserted by (job_id, id)). Agents emit them individually to POST /api/events (upserted by id, also appended to the audit log). Stable id means reruns / state transitions mutate the existing row rather than inserting a duplicate.

id.description: Upsert key — source-provided, must be stable across runs and across state transitions. For calendar events use the source event ID. For metrics use a fixed slug like 'unread-email-count'. For agent events use a stable composite like 'task:<task_id>' or 'chain:<run_id>'.

kind.description: Controls how consumers render the entry. 'metric' displays value prominently; 'event' uses start_at/end_at for timeline positioning.

source.description: Producer + machine identifier — required for agent-event envelopes. Format '<producer>@<machine>' (e.g. 'wails-queue@laptop', 'runner:mac-1', 'brainbox-hub'). Optional for collection-script entries (job_id provides equivalent context).

type.description: Dotted event type — required for agent-event envelopes. Examples: 'task.queued', 'task.failed', 'chain.step.done', 'action.retry', 'runner.heartbeat'. Optional for collection-script entries.

parent_id.description: Optional link to another envelope. Used by agent events to express: action → target, chain step → chain run, child task → parent task. Enables cascading resolution and history drill-down.

description.description: Supporting detail. URLs detected here are rendered as clickable links.

value.description: For kind=metric: the current value (number or string). Ignored for events.

url.description: Primary link — clicking the entry title opens this in the system browser.

start_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. For events: when it starts. For metrics: omit (collected_at is used instead).

end_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Optional end time for events.

status.description: Drives visual treatment in the timeline AND attention surfacing for agent events. 'upcoming' = future/queued; 'active' = in progress; 'done' = completed; 'failed' = terminal error; 'blocked' = waiting on dependency / runner offline (attention-eligible); 'needs_action' = waiting on human input (attention-eligible).

outcome.description: Populated when this envelope IS an action result (type='action.*'). The parent_id then points at the target the action was taken against.

actor.description: Who performed the action. Format 'user', 'agent:<name>', or 'system'.

tags.description: Searchable labels. Used for filtering in the timeline and widgets. Use lowercase kebab-case (e.g. 'calendar', 'work', 'ms-graph').

metadata.description: Arbitrary source-specific data. Any JSON-serialisable values. Not displayed directly but available to actions and future consumers.

actions.description: Buttons rendered on the entry. Entry-level actions take precedence over job-level default_actions.

kind.description: 'open_url' opens url in system browser; 'copy' copies value to clipboard; 'dispatch' sends a task to a brainbox hub agent without confirmation; 'prompt' pre-fills the dispatch form for user review before sending.

agent.description: For kind=dispatch|prompt: target agent name (e.g. 'developer', 'reviewer'). Defaults to 'developer'.

prompt.description: For kind=dispatch: prompt template sent directly to the agent. Supports {field} and {metadata.field} substitution.

template.description: For kind=prompt: pre-filled prompt template opened for user review. Supports {field} and {metadata.field} substitution.

actor.description: Optional — restricts which actor may perform this action. 'user', 'agent:<name>', or 'system'. Omit to allow any actor.
